mentions.name: Jynx
mentions.description: An iOS/Android app that connects gamers with each other. It runs a matching algorithm in the background so users can keep doing what they're doing, and sends a notification when a group or player is found. A beta release is planned within two weeks.
mentions.problem: Finding other players to play with typically requires actively searching and waiting instead of continuing your current activity.
mentions.audience: Gamers of all flavors looking for other players or groups to play with
mentions.source_excerpt:
Working on an iOS/Android app that lets gamers of all flavors connect with each other.

The main selling point of this app is that I do everything to let you continue do what you're doing while the algorithm search for other players. You receive a notification when a group is found or when a player is found.
